blocks.data:
<% if ENV['RAILS_ENV'] == 'production' %>
production:
  adapter: postgresql
  encoding: unicode
  host: <%= ENV['DB_HOST'] %>
  port: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_PORT') { 5432 } %>
  database: <%= ENV['DB_NAME'] %>
  username: <%= ENV['DB_USER'] %>
  password: <%= ENV['DB_PASSWORD'] %>
  pool: <%= ENV.fetch('RAILS_MAX_THREADS') { 5 } %>
  checkout_timeout: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_CHECKOUT_TIMEOUT') { 5 } %>
  idle_timeout: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_IDLE_TIMEOUT') { 300 } %>
  reaping_frequency: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_REAPING_FREQUENCY') { 10 } %>
  variables:
    statement_timeout: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT') { 15000 } %>
    lock_timeout: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_LOCK_TIMEOUT') { 5000 } %>
  replica:
    adapter: postgresql
    encoding: unicode
    host: <%= ENV['DB_REPLICA_HOST'] %>
    database: <%= ENV['DB_NAME'] %>
    username: <%= ENV['DB_REPLICA_USER'] %>
    password: <%= ENV['DB_REPLICA_PASSWORD'] %>
    replica: true
<% elsif ENV['RAILS_ENV'] == 'staging' %>
staging:
  adapter: postgresql
  encoding: unicode
  host: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_HOST') { 'staging-db.internal' } %>
  database: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_NAME') { 'pipeshub_staging' } %>
  username: <%= ENV.fetch('DB_USER') { 'pipeshub' } %>
  password: <%= ENV['DB_PASSWORD'] %>
  pool: <%= ENV.fetch('RAILS_MAX_THREADS') { 5 } %>
<% else %>
development:
  adapter: sqlite3
  database: db/development.sqlite3
  pool: 5
  timeout: 5000
test:
  adapter: sqlite3
  database: db/test.sqlite3
  pool: 5
  timeout: 5000
<% end %>

<% if ENV['REDIS_URL'] %>
cache_store:
  adapter: redis
  url: <%= ENV['REDIS_URL'] %>
  namespace: <%= ENV.fetch('REDIS_NAMESPACE') { 'pipeshub-cache' } %>
  expires_in: <%= ENV.fetch('CACHE_TTL') { 300 } %>
  pool_size: <%= ENV.fetch('REDIS_POOL') { 10 } %>
  reconnect_attempts: 3
  ssl_params:
    verify_mode: <%= ENV.fetch('REDIS_SSL_VERIFY') { 'none' } %>
<% else %>
cache_store:
  adapter: memory_store
  size: 64
<% end %>

<% unless ENV['RAILS_ENV'] == 'test' %>
cable:
  adapter: redis
  url: <%= ENV.fetch('CABLE_REDIS_URL') { ENV['REDIS_URL'] } %>
  channel_prefix: <%= ENV.fetch('CABLE_PREFIX') { 'pipeshub_cable' } %>
  allowed_request_origins:
    - <%= ENV.fetch('FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL') { 'http://localhost:3001' } %>
    - <%= ENV.fetch('ALLOWED_ORIGIN') { 'http://localhost:3000' } %>
<% end %>

active_storage:
  <% if ENV['S3_BUCKET'] %>
  service: s3
  bucket: <%= ENV['S3_BUCKET'] %>
  region: <%= ENV.fetch('S3_REGION') { 'us-east-1' } %>
  prefix: <%= ENV.fetch('S3_PREFIX') { 'uploads' } %>
  upload:
    server_side_encryption: AES256
    cache_control: "public, max-age=31536000"
  <% else %>
  service: disk
  root: <%= Rails.root.join('storage') %>
  <% end %>

smtp:
  <% if ENV['SMTP_HOST'] %>
  delivery_method: smtp
  address: <%= ENV['SMTP_HOST'] %>
  port: <%= ENV.fetch('SMTP_PORT') { 587 } %>
  domain: <%= ENV.fetch('SMTP_DOMAIN') { 'pipeshub.com' } %>
  user_name: <%= ENV['SMTP_USER'] %>
  password: <%= ENV['SMTP_PASSWORD'] %>
  authentication: <%= ENV.fetch('SMTP_AUTH') { 'plain' } %>
  enable_starttls_auto: true
  default_from: <%= ENV.fetch('SMTP_FROM') { 'noreply@pipeshub.com' } %>
  <% else %>
  delivery_method: <%= ENV.fetch('MAIL_DELIVERY') { 'letter_opener' } %>
  default_from: developer@localhost
  <% end %>

sidekiq:
  concurrency: <%= ENV.fetch('SIDEKIQ_CONCURRENCY') { 10 } %>
  timeout: <%= ENV.fetch('SIDEKIQ_TIMEOUT') { 25 } %>
  queues:
    - [critical, 5]
    - [default, 3]
    - [mailers, 2]
    - [indexing, 2]
    - [low, 1]
  redis:
    url: <%= ENV.fetch('SIDEKIQ_REDIS_URL') { ENV['REDIS_URL'] } %>
    network_timeout: 5
    pool_timeout: 5

# application
  name: pipeshub
  secret_key_base: <%= ENV['SECRET_KEY_BASE'] %>
  encryption_key: <%= ENV['ENCRYPTION_KEY'] %>
  jwt:
    issuer: <%= ENV.fetch('JWT_ISSUER') { 'pipeshub' } %>
    audience: <%= ENV.fetch('JWT_AUDIENCE') { 'pipeshub-api' } %>
    expiry_seconds: <%= ENV.fetch('JWT_EXPIRY') { 3600 } %>
  features:
    search: <%= ENV.fetch('FEATURE_SEARCH') { 'true' } %>
    agents: <%= ENV.fetch('FEATURE_AGENTS') { 'true' } %>
    mcp: <%= ENV.fetch('FEATURE_MCP') { 'true' } %>
    sandbox: <%= ENV.fetch('FEATURE_SANDBOX') { 'false' } %>
